source_summary: Vertical ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with a broad water expanse, distant low hills and shoreline at the top, a monumental foreground crag with wind-bent pines on the left and center, and a small fishing boat with a seated figure at lower right. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_low_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the thin, far background ridge of low mountains and shoreline running across the upper-left to upper-middle horizon, excluding the denser settlement details at far right.
must_preserve: delicate wavering contour lines of the low hills
pale ink wash inside the ridge forms
thin horizontal shoreline strokes
subtle layered silhouettes suggesting recession through mist

motifs.name: far_right_shore_settlement
motifs.description: Isolate the compact far-right shoreline cluster with low hills, small dark tree marks, roof-like strokes, bank contours, and bridge-like arcs along the distant shore.
must_preserve: tiny clustered dot-and-line tree marks
angular roof and bank geometry
arched bridge-like strokes near the right edge
overlapping pale hill washes behind the shore
fine broken ink lines indicating paths and embankments

motifs.name: upper_left_clifftop_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the wind-bent tree and leafy clifftop projection in the upper-left foreground, including the leaning trunk, sparse crown, dark rock lip, and surrounding foliage washes.
must_preserve: leaning trunk contour with abrupt bends
spattered leaf clusters in light and dark ink
dark horizontal rock ledge beneath the foliage
ragged dry-brush edges of the canopy
pale wash suggesting cliff mass behind the tree

motifs.name: central_pale_cliff_face
motifs.description: Isolate the tall pale cliff face descending from the upper-left ledge into the center, including its vertical wash, dark side contours, rootlike branches, and attached shrubs, but excluding the seal at far left.
motifs.role: foreground cliff face and rock wash
must_preserve: soft vertical ink wash on the pale cliff surface
dark irregular contour line along the cliff edge
rootlike branch tracery crossing the ledge
small shrubs rendered with dry broken strokes
misty, uneven transition between rock and open water

motifs.name: central_gnarled_pine_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central mass of gnarled pine branches and rocky texture spreading diagonally across the middle foreground, separate from the far-right bough and lower-left base.
must_preserve: thick black twisting branch lines
short angular pine-needle clusters
dry-brush rock creases and cracks
layered gray-brown wash under the branches
ragged negative spaces between limbs and foliage

motifs.name: lower_left_cliff_base
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left rooted cliff base with heavy dark ink, exposed trunk-like rock forms, tangled roots, and scrub at the foot of the large foreground structure.
must_preserve: bold saturated black root and trunk strokes
vertical rock-face wash with darker pooling at the base
jagged dry-brush cracks
small wiry shrubs along the lower edge
irregular silhouette of the cliff foot

motifs.name: right_overhanging_pine_bough
motifs.description: Isolate the large horizontal pine bough extending from the central crag toward the right, with clustered needles, angular twigs, and dark knotted branch joints.
must_preserve: sweeping horizontal branch structure
dense black pine-needle tufts
angular twig network at the tips
knotted dark ink accents along the limb
light wash patches behind and within the foliage masses

motifs.name: fishing_boat_with_fisherman
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat at lower right with the seated fisherman or scholar figure, canopy or bundled cargo, mast-like vertical pole, curved hull, and trailing line on the water.
must_preserve: curved narrow hull outline
seated figure with straw-hat-like head and robe strokes
small cargo or canopy texture in the boat
single vertical pole or mast line
fine trailing fishing line and sparse water strokes around the bow and stern

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
